data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 供品桌上的参拜·「供品检查……由内到外哦♪」
data.description: 【神殿供品桌·黄昏】「今日供品质量不合格——缺少了最重要的东西。」女神把供品桌上的果盘推到一边，俯身撑住桌沿，裙裾被掀到腰际，金链内衣在暮色里叮当作响——「缺的东西就是……嗯哈……你自己想想是什么！供品检查，由内到外哦♪ 稍微仔细一点……才算合格……」
data.action: 撑供品桌塌腰翘臀更衣整理受力，金链内衣勒出肉感，红瞳含泪回眸微嗔
data.lighting: 黄昏橙光斜洒供品与肌肤
data.camera: horizontal POV, leaning over offering table, arched spine, waist chain, looking back, dusk scene
data.promptProse: Ishtar sweeps the ceremonial offerings aside and leans forward over the temple table at dusk, her short black skirt lifted as the delicate gold chains around her hips chime with every breath. Looking back over her bare shoulder with a defiant, blushing glare in her ruby eyes, she bites her full lower lip while trembling fingers steady her arched posture. Warm amber twilight spills across the offering altar, highlighting the graceful curve of her back, taut waist, and flushed thighs in an arresting horizontal composition, detailed background.
